verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Copilot Chat and agent mode work in JetBrains IDEs, including proposing/validating file edits, which implies some diff-like review, but there is no explicit documentation of an interactive diff viewer or a dedicated 'share selected code as context' feature specifically for JetBrains. Missing for 10: explicit JetBrains diff UI documentation, explicit selected-code-as-context mechanism, independent confirmation of these JetBrains-specific UX elements.
